messages:
olivia: Heads-up: after yesterday's fp8 roll with calib-level=2 we saw a perf regression on long-context runs and some JSON-structured output failures. attaching quick notes. :warning:

sam: Can you paste the repro command and the perf numbers?

olivia: repro command I used:
```
./run_profile.sh --model redwood-7b --quant fp8 --calib-level 2 --ctx 4096 --batch 8 --route fastpath
```

olivia: Observed median token latency increased from ~210ms -> ~280ms for that route on p4. Also eval delta: json-struct exact-match dropped ~6.3%, hallucination metric +4%.

kevin: Interesting. profiler shows kernel picker choosing gemm_fp8_fast for KV matmul but falling back to gemm_int8 in a few layers after warmup. sample lines:
```
[profiler] layer 8: selected gemm_fp8_fast (est 120ms)
[profiler] layer 9: fallback to gemm_int8 (est 180ms)
latency per token: 213ms -> 278ms
```

kevin: fallback seems triggered when per-layer scale variance > threshold. calibration stage may have changed per-channel scales.

mia: Could the calibration pass have produced noisy clipping for some heads? We saw similar before where per-tensor calib hides outliers and causes numeric drift in attention scores, breaking JSON output ordering.

sam: Do we have traces showing attention softmax distributions pre/post calib? Even a couple layers would help.

olivia: attaching small trace excerpt (pasted):
```
layer9: pre-softmax std=0.43 -> post-calib std=0.62 (shifted mean -0.12)
layer12: qk scale multiplier per-channel variance increased 3x
```

ci-bot: E2E tests for json-struct on canary failed 7/120, baseline 0/120. Triggered rollback flag not set.

kevin: Hypothesis: calibration produced per-channel scales that make fp8 kernel numerics unstable on long ctx, kernel fallback thrashes between fp8 and int8 causing cache/KV alignment issues and structured-token reorder.

mia: Quick mitigations we can try:
- revert calib-level to 1 for this model
- force kernel selection to stable gemm_int8 for long ctx routes
- run per-head calibration and compare

olivia: Action items:
- kevin to add a quick flag to force kernel=int8 on canary and rerun perf + e2e (ETA 2h)
- sam to gather attention distribution diffs for layers 8-13 (ETA 3h)
- mia to run per-head calibration draft and share numbers (ETA EOD)
- olivia to open an eval ticket with failing examples and attach run artifacts

sam: ping @kevin when the forced-int8 Canary is up, I'll run the json-struct suite.

kevin: starting canary now, will post results.

olivia: thanks team. we'll sync in retro if needed. :thumbsup:
